name: Regent Shanghai Pudong
insider_take: This towering luxury sanctuary in Pudong offers some of Shanghai's most breathtaking skyline views from its perch in the financial district.
whats_special: Located in the heart of Pudong's gleaming financial district, this elegant hotel sits just steps from the iconic Oriental Pearl Tower and Shanghai World Financial Center. The property features floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing panoramic views of the Huangpu River and historic Bund district across the water. The hotel's signature Cantonese restaurant holds court on the upper floors, while the spa incorporates traditional Chinese wellness philosophies.
pro_tip: Book a Huangpu River-facing room on floors 25+ for unobstructed sunset views over the Bund's colonial architecture – the golden hour light reflecting off the water is absolutely magical.
dont_miss: Take the short walk to the Shanghai World Financial Center's observation deck on the 100th floor, then stroll through the nearby Century Park for a peaceful escape from the urban energy. The hotel's location also puts you minutes from the Maglev train terminal for a thrilling 430km/h ride to the airport.
pros: Stunning Huangpu River and Bund skyline views from premium location
Exceptional personalized service with high staff-to-guest ratio
Spacious luxury suites with sophisticated contemporary design
Multiple award-winning dining venues including Michelin-starred options
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects ultra-high-end positioning
Limited recreational facilities compared to resort-style properties
